prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 29.4% higher than a year ago. Also in its favour: over the past year the share did 31.2 percentage points better than the Nifty 50; the share price is close to its 52-week high; and profit grew 118% compared with a year earlier. Other areas on this side: growth, the balance sheet, what the price asks for the earnings.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on price behaviour: the 3-year maximum drawdown was -44.2%, a deep fall. Also against it: one-year volatility is 35.8%, high.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 12 points in favour and 2 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 76 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend. That gives an educational rating of Buy with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
